title: Rick & Morty Explain Neural Networks! 🤖🧠
caption: Ever wondered how AI learns? Let Rick and Morty break it down for you! #AIExplained

scenes.script: Alright, Morty, listen up. You know that brain of yours? Well, neural networks are like little brains that learn from data.
Wait, so it's like when I learned to recognize your stupid face after seeing you a million times?
Exactly, Morty! The network sees data, like your stupid face, and learns patterns through layers of math stuff. It's called forward propagation.
But how does it know if it's right or wrong?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Good question, Morty. It uses something called a loss function to measure errors. If it guesses your face is a potato, the loss goes up.
scenes.web_image: person comparing a potato to a human face

scenes.script: That's terrible! But how does it fix its mistakes?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty super angry biting his lips and frowning.png
scenes.web_image: someone correcting their mistakes on paper

scenes.script: It uses backpropagation to adjust the weights and biases. Think of weights as how much attention it pays to your nose, and biases as shifting its guess.
So, the more it sees your face, the better it gets? Like when I watch your stupid show a million times?
Yep! It trains in epochs, like rerunning the same episodes. But if it gets too good at your face and bad at other things, that's overfitting.
scenes.web_image: person memorizing a script instead of understanding

scenes.script: But what about those fancy modern networks like CNNs and transformers? How do they work?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png
scenes.web_image: computer vision applications in real life

scenes.script: Transformers handle sequences, like your dumb jokes. CNNs are great at images, like recognizing more of my stupid face.
Okay, but why should I care? What's the point?
Because these networks power everything from your stupid smartphone to generative AI, Morty. And without them, you'd still be stuck in that dimension where I never invented the portal gun!

topic: How does a neural network learn from data?
